source.snippet: Is there a coaching feature in lifesciences cloud in Salesforce. The requirement is to teach a sales rep or msls about the visit feature and record that a coaching visit call is completed for reporting purposes. My proposed solution: Have a checkbox 'coaching call' on visit record... I have noticed engagement coaching as an object which is related to visit record as parent record.

problem_statement: Pharmaceutical sales operations teams using Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud lack a clear, configurable way to track coaching visits tied to field rep activity, forcing admins to build brittle workarounds on standard objects.
target_segment: Salesforce admins and solution architects at pharmaceutical or life sciences companies using Health Cloud / Life Sciences Cloud
notes: Salesforce ecosystem signals paid professional context — these admins or their employers pay Salesforce enterprise licensing. The gap between what Life Sciences Cloud provides and what regulated pharma sales ops requires is a recurring consulting and ISV opportunity. Single post; needs volume corroboration.
